# dsh-think-summary
English | 简体中文

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns each
reasoning step into **one or two plain sentences**, so a 3

0-minute long-horizon run stays
skimmable. The full chain of thought is still one click away.
> Community plugin. Not affiliated with or maintained by DeepSeek AI.
## The problem
Harness renders the model's **raw** chain of thought. In a long task that means:

- collapsed: a one-line excerpt that tells you nothing, plus a step list like
"ran a command, read a

file, searched code";
- expanded: several thousand words of stream-of-consciousness, in the order t

he model
happened to think it.

Codex feels different because it shows a **summary that the model itself produces**
(OpenAI's reason

ing-summary channel). DeepSeek has no such channel — the only way to get
that experience is to gener
ate the summary locally, one extra cheap call per step.

pseTiming: next-input` for `ui-chat` in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`. The
latest turn then stay
s open until your next message.

## Configure
Configuration lives in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (or the plugin's config panel):
[代码示例省略，未执行]
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch. `false` keeps the UI but makes no model calls. |
| `provider`

/ `model` | `opencode-go` / `deepseek-v4.1-flash` | Route used for summarising. |
| `maxInputChars`

| `6000` | Reasoning is clamped head+tail beyond this. |
| `maxOutputTokens` | `2000` | Total comple

tion budget. |
| `timeoutMs` | `25000` | Per-call timeout. |
| `minChars` | `160` | Steps shorter th

an this are not worth a call. |
| `maxCallsPerSession` / `maxCallsTotal` | `300` / `600` | Hard cost

ceilings. |
| `cacheFile` | `~/.dsh/storages/think-summary/cache.json` | Persisted cache. |

Emergency switch: `localStorage.setItem('dsh-think-summary.enabled', 'false')` in the
browser disabl
es requests for that page without touching the profile.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- The client registers `conversation.chat.node` at `priority: -1` for `assistant-step`,
filtering bl

ocks exactly like the shipped renderer (`groupPart` rules, `text` /
`reasoning` / `image`; tool call

s stay separate nodes).
- A summary is requested only when a step **settles** — never mid-stream.
-

Summaries are keyed by a SHA-1 of the (clamped) reasoning text, so identical text is
never billed tw

ice, and the cache survives restarts.
- Any failure (no route, timeout, truncation, empty output) de

grades to the original
one-line excerpt. The plugin can never make the transcript worse than stock.
## Cost and latency

One cheap call per settled step. On `deepseek-v4.1-flash` a typical step takes 3–20 s
and a few thou

sand input tokens; the answer itself is ~3 short lines. A 40-step run is
well under one unit of curr

ency on most routes — but this is a **paid** feature, so the
budgets above exist on purpose.

Rows older than three hours are not backfilled; opening an old session does not trigger
a wave of ca

older than three hours are not backfilled; opening an old session does not trigger
a wave of calls.

The client also rate-limits itself with a **sliding window of 60 requests per 10 minutes**.
When the

window is full the row shows `摘要已暂停` (summary paused) and recovers
automatically once it slides — r

eplacing the old lifetime cap of 240 requests per page,
which a long-lived desktop window could exha

ust permanently. Host-side `skipped` answers
(budget exhausted / disabled) suppress that text for te

n minutes, so scrolling a row in and
out no longer re-hits the endpoint.
## Privacy and security

- Reasoning text is sent **only** to the provider you configure — the same provider that
already ser

ves the conversation.
- Summaries are cached locally at `~/.dsh/storages/think-summary/cache.json`.

- The HTTP endpoint (`/dsh-think-summary/*`) accepts loopback connections only, caps
request bodies

at 512 KB, requires `POST` for summarising, and runs at most two model
calls at a time.
- No telemet
ry, no analytics, no network calls other than the model request.
## Compatibility
- Harness `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.2.3-0`; verified on `0.2.2-rc.1` using the desktop profile (the same web

client Harness serves).
- The plugin shadows the shipped `assistant-step` renderer. A Harness releas

e that
changes the node contract can break rendering; the renderer is wrapped in an error
boundary t
hat falls back to plain text.
## Limitations

- **File mentions** (`@path`) inside assistant text render as plain text for now.
- **Chinese bullet

s only** — the prompt asks for Chinese; other languages are not wired up.
- **Reasoning effort canno

t be disabled** on routes that only expose `low/high/max`, so
`maxOutputTokens` must leave room for

thinking. That is why the default is 2000.
- **History is not fully backfilled** (3-hour window) to

keep costs predictable.
- Tool calls are still rendered by Harness itself; only `assistant-step` nod

ctable.
- Tool calls are still rendered by Harness itself; only `assistant-step` nodes are shadowed.
## Troubleshooting
| Symptom | Check |
| No bullets anywhere | Is the plugin enabled? `curl http://127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-think-summary/statu

s` |
| Row shows `摘要已暂停` | Hover for the reason: rate window (wait for it to slide) or budget (raise

the host ceilings) |
